Formula f_{X|Y}(x|y)=f(x,y)/f_Y(y). Need f_Y(y)=∫ f(x,y) dx over x such that 0<x<y,0<y<1 => ∫_0^y 2 dx = 2y. Then f_{X|Y}=2/(2y)=1/y for 0<x<y, y in (0,1). Options: A has 1/x and 0<y<x; B 1/(2x); C 1/y for 0<x<y; D 1/(2y) |x|<y. Correct C. Need final line answer: C. Need maybe provide concise reasoning. Ensure final format exactly "答案：C" last line. content:
要求条件密度  
\[
f_{X|Y}(x\mid y)=\frac{f(x,y)}{f_Y(y)}.
\]

先求边缘密度 \(f_Y(y)\)。当 \(0<y<1\) 时，\(x\) 的取值范围是 \(0<x<y\)，所以  
\[
f_Y(y)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} f(x,y)\,dx=\int_0^y 2\,dx=2y.
\]

因此  
\[
f_{X|Y}(x\mid y)=\frac{2}{2y}=\frac{1}{y},\qquad 0<x<y.
\]

所以正确选项是 C。

答案：C
